text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. I drew up a design last
night and have informed our
helpers of our
progress. Our meeting is scheduled for 11
a.m.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There's seven days, one hour, and two
minutes left until the contest. Our goals
for this weekend are to finalize the
design and draft a
recipe.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let's give it all we have, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I've created a three-tier cake by layering
chocolate sponges. There's
a road running
diagonally down the cake from top to
bottom.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To top it off,
I'm thinking of decorating it
with matcha frosting and
cake, then
etching a laurel leaf pattern...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This doesn't quite portray each student's
pursuit of victory. I will
revise the design,
and make one more—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry. We're three minutes into our
scheduled break time. Let's go
outside for
a change of scenery.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We have one minute and thirteen seconds
left of our break. I thought three minutes
wouldn't be too bad,
but it's a bit chilly,
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Um, Flash...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this is off-topic, but your words
and facial expressions
suggest that your
current status is "passionate."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is somewhat unusual. You've appeared
relatively unfazed until now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...It's a little embarrassing to put into
words, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Each and every one of us at the academy
wants to win... That
realization stirred my
heart a little.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Then your status is... "stirred"?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even though it sounds obvious,
it's not. No student has to care about
winning or
losing, necessarily. They could just be
happy to be here.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But, if I think about it, I've never met
anyone like that here. Everyone
takes the
initiative and single-mindedly chases
victory.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This academy is part of my life plan—that
part hasn't changed. But now I think that
there's much more to be gained here than
I'd
imagined.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My reason for joining the contest was to
show gratitude to my family's
business
partners, but now there's more to it than
that.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I want to show my respect to Tracen
Academy. I want to let the world
know
what a wonderful place this is.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Right now, that's all I can think about.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Analyzing status.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your verbalization has caused a short in
my memory banks.
Status—"bewildered",
and...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"In agreement"... No, it's more than
agreement. I hypothesize the
warmth in my
chest is akin to excitement. What is this?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Bourbon...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
so you feel it too... This is getting
more embarrassing by the
minute, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! You're lookin' cold over there,
besties!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! We come
bearing the tastiest of treats!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see!
So the theme for this cake is what we
all have in common—the
desire to win!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Despite everyone's unique
personalities, we all have the same
goal in
mind.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Our daily routines and the things we pour
our efforts into differ between us, but in
our own way, we're all aiming for the same
thing. I
hope to convey that...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Jordan? What are you thinking?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I didn't realize our lives were all so
different. For starters, we all wake
up at
mad different times.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Be it in your perspectives, your
friendships, or even the kind of lunch you
have, the three of you are surprisingly
different. I imagine our results would be
the same even if we observed the whole
school.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Do you have any thoughts on it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Um, yeah, it's like... Highlighter...
What was it again? Like,
highlight-ening?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Enlightening?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Flower. Wanna grab lunch after this?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Lunch... with me?
